Question
========
Which of the following statements about using shortcuts for imports is true?

Answerlist
-----------
* `import numpy as np` allows you to refer to the library as `np`.
* `import numpy as n` will automatically create a function called `n`
* Shortcuts are not allowed in Python
* `import matplotlib.pyplot as mp` lets you use `mp.plot(...)` only
* Using shortcuts changes the library functionality
* After `import numpy as np`, you must still use `numpy.loadtxt(...)`

Solution
========
Using `import numpy as np` lets you call `np.loadtxt()` etc. It is a naming shortcut.
